method: WebSearch + WebFetch, max 4 calls per pair, queries limited to public facility name, city and service. Directory pages that repeat dataset source text are treated as weak.

Satna District Hospital blood bank exists (2025 HIV transfusion news), but record PIN 483501 and website dhkatni.org point to District Hospital Katni; a blood bank record is not itself an emergency unit and no credible page was checked for trauma care.
